integrity: The infinite limits follow from the analytical local chord-versus-arc estimates. Forty-four finite numerical checks corroborate but do not prove them.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed p>1 and root-of-unity angular grid only. No optimal sampling, mixed p/n limit, higher dimension, or rate for the metric-projection algorithm is claimed. Historical priority remains provisional because not all specialized chordal-quadrature literature was inspected.
title: A critical perimeter-loss transition and three arithmetic grid phases for superelliptic polygons
